text.tspan: (runs once, from the base branch — or production, hotfix only)
there is no login step — every call below authenticates
per-request as --role assigner, so everything is filed BY the assigner
the healthcheck already read the current branch —
step 2 judges that row rather than asking GIT again
base → continue · production → continue, hotfix only (step 5C decides)
feature/hotfix → stop · detached HEAD → stop (nothing nameable to cut from)
Step 8 — no code, no commits, no PRs.
Hand-off: cd into each worktree and run /jira-sdlc:jira-task-executor
with no key argument — phase 2 starts there

svg.text: Step 2 — branch context, from the healthcheck's branch row
+ base — planned work (default) or explicit hotfix
+ git pull --ff-only origin BRANCH_FROM (planned work only)
(reads .jst config, no Jira call — no email configured → stop)
(multistep is always the planned path — feature/ from development),
set parentbranch config, push, add parent worktree
Step 6A — create branch + worktree from the chosen base
Step 6B — post "PR target branch: ... Worktree: ..." comment
Step 7 — post report comment (on the parent issue)
first line is the "Assignment report" marker the executor greps for
